title: Fix Storybook Story Loading
description: Fix Storybook so stories load correctly in `elements/ui` and eliminate the browser-side `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading dirname)` error caused by runtime bundling of server-only configuration modules.
summary: Removed server-only configuration re-exports from the `@elements/ui` runtime entrypoint so Storybook no longer bundles `eslint.config.ts` and `typescript-eslint` into the browser. Verified with a successful `npm run build` in `elements/ui`.
